CRITICAL_FEHB_CARVE_IN_CONTRADICTS_TASK_.located_claim: The Federal Employees Health Benefits (FEHB) Program, Affordable Care (Health Exchange) Plans, and insurance provided through state employee plans are NOT federal or state government health care programs for purposes of this savings offer.
CRITICAL_FEHB_CARVE_IN_CONTRADICTS_TASK_.why_it_matters: The task premise asserted copay cards universally exclude FEHB. For Novo Nordisk the located terms say the OPPOSITE. If the engine suppresses the Novo copay-card pathway for an FEHB enrollee it would wrongly deny that user a real discount. This divergence must be resolved by direct read before either behavior is encoded.

CRITICAL_SELF_PAY_ELECTION_BARRED_FOR_TH.located_claim: Patients enrolled in federal or state health care programs may not use this program even if they elect to be processed as an uninsured or self-paying patient.
CRITICAL_SELF_PAY_ELECTION_BARRED_FOR_TH.why_it_matters: This closes the self-pay loophole for the SAVINGS OFFER specifically. It is NOT the same document as the NovoCare Pharmacy cash-pay terms and must not be conflated with them.
